stem: What is the best paraphrase of paragraph 1?

options.label: A
options.text: When Kevin's friends put their instruments away, Kevin falls before he is able to pack up his trumpet.

options.label: B
options.text: After band practice, while Kevin's friends pack their instruments, Kevin accidentally dents his trumpet when he trips over a music stand.

options.label: C
options.text: Kevin and his friends put away their instruments after band practice. Jimmy notices that Kevin's trumpet has many dents.

options.label: D
options.text: Kevin trips while his friends are packing up their instruments after band practice. A music stand falls over and makes a loud sound.
